title: audit-archive-stream
blurb: A chunked audit export still retains the complete query and every formatted record before its first upload.
brief:
An audit archiver is configured to upload 128-record chunks, yet the heap evidence shows every source row and formatted record live at the first upload. Production exports contain millions of rows.

Start with `diagnostics/heap-summary.txt` and `diagnostics/allocation-trace.txt`, then inspect `archive/exporter.py`. Output bytes are already correct.

**Your job:** preserve order and exact output while making traversal one-pass, bounded, and prompt on sink failure.
